 Filming for The Families Stone has officially begun!
 Sarah Jessica Parker and Dermot Mulroney were seen arriving on set to film scenes for the upcoming sequel to The Family Stone on Wednesday afternoon (October 21) in Brooklyn, New York.
 26 
 26 
 Fellow cast members seen on set included OG stars Claire Danes and Luke Wilson .
 Maggie Siff , who did not appear in the first movie, was also spotted on set, seemingly revealing that she has joined the cast for the new sequel.
 26 
 The Families Stone was announced last month . Thomas Bezucha , who wrote and directed the 2005 fan-favorite holiday movie, will be returning for the sequel to write and direct again.
 Fellow returning cast members include Rachel McAdams , Craig T. Nelson , Tyrone Giordano , Elizabeth Reaser , Paul Schneider and Brian White .
 The sequel takes place 20 years after the death of Stone family matriarch Sybil, who was played by the late Diane Keaton .
 26 
 26 
 The family will reunite for Christmas once again, but this time their father Kelly, played by Craig , has a major surprise: he’s fallen in love with another woman and invited her to meet the family. 
 It was recently announced that this Emmy-winning actress will be playing the new love interest!
